en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing three people dressed in old-fashioned rural clothing at a rustic outdoor setup. There is a small turf-roofed hut, a man standing behind a makeshift wooden counter with bottles, and two women sitting on either side. The setting is a hilly, grassy landscape. The upper part of the postcard contains printed text in French describing the location and features.
